findings.issue: הָיְתָה is qal perfect 3fs and שִׁכְבַת is a feminine singular construct noun (the head that ‘was’), with הַטַּל only the genitive. ‘fue tendido del rocío’ turns that noun into a masculine passive ‘was spread’, drops the layer as subject, and adds a stretching/spreading action.

notes: The evening, quail, covering, morning, and around-to-the-camp clauses match the tokens.
